items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: No Miles’ tunes, I know that tune, the record I’m thinking of is the one with Trane and Philly Joe...

ctx.x: Yes it is and the tune called “Miles.” [scats]. I love that record.

No Miles’ tunes, I know that tune, the record I’m thinking of is the one with Trane and Philly Joe and they do trio stuff with Red Garland I guess, but they do “Salt Peanuts” I think and stuff like that. Anyway, any of that stuff. God it would be hard to pick one. Aw there’s so many, and Duke. “Duke at Newport” I guess would be the — but “Duke at Newport” is — I mean if you wanted, if someone says what is swing? What is swinging? Just put on “Duke at Newport.” Put on “Dimenuendo and Crescendo in Blue” with Paul…
